# [CS075] Unauthorized Security Suppression Added in Diff (unauthorized-suppression-added)

A change adds an inline ignore, an ignore-file entry or a setting that hides findings.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Severity** | CRITICAL |
| **Category** | Security |
| **CWE** | [CWE-693](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/693.html) |
| **OWASP** | A06:2025 |
| **Auto-Fix supported** | No |

## Why It Matters in Go

With --forbid-new-suppressions, lines added since the --diff reference (HEAD by default) are checked: //codex:ignore, //nolint and #nosec in Go comments, entries in the ignore file, and configuration that disables rules, excludes paths or relaxes thresholds. Directive-like text in string literals, comments in the ignore file, tightened settings and suppressions that a removed line already contained are not reported. The finding cannot itself be suppressed; CI approves a reviewed change by setting CODEX_ALLOW_SUPPRESSIONS=1.

## Vulnerable / Problematic Example

```go
rows, err := db.Query("SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = " + id) //codex:ignore sql-injection -- fix later
```

## Safe / Idiomatic Go Pattern

```go
rows, err := db.Query("SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = $1", id)
```

## Configuration & Suppression

Disable the rule for the whole module in `.codexsentinel.yaml`:

```yaml
rules:
  disabled: [unauthorized-suppression-added]
```

Change its severity:

```yaml
rules:
  severity_overrides:
    unauthorized-suppression-added: low
```

Suppress one reviewed finding on its line, with the reason:

```go
//codex:ignore unauthorized-suppression-added -- <reason>
```

Or ignore it under a path in `.codexsentinel.ignore`:

```text
internal/legacy/** unauthorized-suppression-added
```
